Company Mission

Rubedo Life Sciences is an anti-aging company with the mission of extending

health-span by targeting cells in the body in an accurate and safe way. We aim to

remove from the body "bad cells" that drive aging (such as the pro-inflammatory

senescent cells), and to improve the functions of "good cells" (such as stem

cells). Founded by leaders in aging, regenerative medicine, and chemistry from

top institutions like Stanford, Berkeley, and major tech and life science firms, we

are building a world-class science, bioinformatics and engineering team. The goal

of the bioinformatics team is to enhance drug discovery using bioinformatics,

machine learning, and software engineering applied against high resolution

multi-omic data and imaging.


Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and driven Senior Software Engineer to join our

team at our Italian site, Rubedo Life Sciences Italy S.r.l.. In this role, you will be

responsible for leading large projects, designing and implementing complex

analysis algorithms, and building out our bioinformatics software platform. As a

technical leader, you will be expected to scope and design projects, identify

necessary resources, and potentially lead execution. You will serve as a key

technical mentor, reviewing code changes, enforcing design decisions, and

becoming a subject matter expert in core aspects of our platform.


Key Responsibilities

● Design and build scalable bioinformatics software platforms and analysis

pipelines.

● Develop and implement novel algorithms to process and analyze multi-omic

and high-resolution imaging data.

● Develop and implement AI/ML models for analyzing multi-omic and

high-resolution imaging data.

● Analyze bioinformatic data and present findings.

● Collaborate with leadership at Rubedo to scope and execute complex

programs.

● Identify areas for improvement in our platform, procedures, and analysis

methods to drive technical innovation.

● Mentor team members, review code changes, and enforce high standards

of software design and best practices.

● Act as a subject matter expert in one or more important aspects of the

software platform.


Qualifications

● Significant education or experience in Computer Science, Bioinformatics,

Data Science, or a related engineering field.

● Demonstrated ability to lead projects, collaborate with and mentor

teammates, and innovate within a technical environment.

● Strong proficiency in Python software development.

● Proficiency in operating within a Linux environment.

● Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including modern

software development lifecycles and source control.

● Proven experience in designing and implementing scalable software

solutions and analysis methods.

● Demonstrated knowledge and application of statistical methods.

● Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with scientists and

cross-functional teams to solve challenging technical and scientific

problems.
